Explicit save and genuine four-button reset retain the paid ride, cash 136, one completion and Core park 754.25/720. Subsecond normalizes 54 to 0 and safe coordinates change; reset is not an identical 58-byte copy. Frame 3766 alights at 640/176 with no additional fare.

Ordinary northbound samples 10032/10048/10064 show actual fleet and actor centres 808/160, 808/152, 808/144. limitations: Scope belongs only to exact d58b ROM/source/runtime. Historical Queen and thirteen-job/Island campaign observations remain pinned to their respective 5ae4 and 7b2 ROMs; they are not inherited by this manifest.

The native northbound human samples show normal body clearance; seeded 9px bus/human waiting and resumption remain host actual-C evidence. Human impact/fines, higher-heat pursuit, all fleet/district crowd cases and whole-city latency remain pending on this candidate.
Bus geometry is a fictional partial Core ambient loop; it is not a synchronized visible paid 94 bus, researched real TTC timetable or proof of broader service routes.

Sampled native bus passes and six legs do not establish every road-user crossing, all 96 contracts, complete Old Toronto, fuller Islands, two measured enjoyable human hours or handheld steering feedback.

Linked 1,097-byte reserve is not deepest-stack measurement. Final OAM sample peak 6 does not prove all-city scanlines or frame pacing. Physical cartridge boot, device stream/flash/manual hardware, browser restart and legacy save imports remain separate pending gates.

Relative archive paths and hashes are portable evidence locators, not public downloadable ROMs, PNGs or saves. This manifest contains no binary image, SRAM save, activation state or machine absolute path.
